title: Home Decor AI UGC Ads | AIVideosUGC
description: Make AI UGC ads for every home decor item in minutes. Paste a product link or a photo, pick an avatar, and download a clip without booking a creator.
h1: Home Decor Ads in Minutes, Not Weeks
lead: Making a new ad for every home decor item is slow, and last month's clip rarely fits the next one. Make a fresh ad for each item in minutes.
card: Room scenes, cleaning demos, and organizing moments from one home product photo.

faq.q: Can I make an ad for every item in the catalog?
faq.a: Yes. Each item can start from its own photo or link, and you still review every file before it posts.

faq.q: Do I need a creator or a studio?
faq.a: No. Pick an AI avatar instead of booking a model or a set. A failed clip returns the credits.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the listing, or add the photo by hand if you do not have a link.

faq.q: Can I pick an avatar that fits the room?
faq.a: Yes. Choose a creator-style avatar that fits the look of the room, and keep that face for the next piece.

faq.q: How fast is the first home decor ad?
faq.a: You can have a clip in minutes, not after a week of scheduling a shoot.

faq.q: Can I post the clip on TikTok or Meta?
faq.a: Yes. Download the file, or send it to the feed you already use. A paid plan has no watermark.

faq.q: Can I change the line after the first cut?
faq.a: Yes. Edit the sentence, the voice, or the caption, and make the next version from the same photo.

faq.q: What does a home decor video cost?
faq.a: A photo is 24 credits. A video is 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.

faq.q: Can one photo cover more than one scene?
faq.a: Yes. Use the same photo for another room scene, then keep the version you would actually post.
